channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Cury celebra crescimento nas pesquisas e diz que vai 'pacificar' o país
item.description: Augusto Cury, Avante's presidential candidate, celebrated growing poll numbers and promised to 'pacify' the country. At a rally in Araçatuba, he criticized political polarization and advocated for a administration focused on national unity.

item.title: Zema divulga teaser do “episódio mais importante” de “Intocáveis”
item.description: Romeu Zema released a teaser of an episode from his AI-generated series 'Intocáveis', criticizing Moraes and the Master case, with new content following a crisis at the STF.

item.title: Fachin atrasa casos que envolvem Moraes e Vorcaro até 22 de setembro
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin delayed rulings on investigations involving ministers Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça, with deadlines extending beyond the 2026 election date. One case will be analyzed after September 14 and another after September 22, sparking criticism for postponing responses in an electoral context. Fachin justified the postponement based on legal deadlines and statements from those involved.

item.title: Caiado promete reforma do Judiciário e indicação de quatro mulheres ao STF
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado pledged to appoint four women to the STF and reform the Judiciary, advocating gender parity and the removal of Alexandre de Moraes. He justified the appointments by arguing the Court needs a 'reality shock' and greater sensitivity. The proposal emerges amid an internal crisis in the STF.

item.title: 57% dos eleitores se dizem mais decididos a votar neste ano do que estavam em 2022, diz Datafolha
item.description: Datafolha reports that 57% of voters are more determined to vote in 2026 than in 2022. Among candidates, Lula leads with 38%, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro (33%) and Cury (8%). Voters backing Flávio and Lula show higher engagement, while Zema and Caiado supporters are less decisive.

item.title: Flávio se diz decepcionado com Alcolumbre e cobra impeachment de Moraes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro called for an impeachment process against Supreme Court minister Alexandre de Moraes and criticized Davi Alcolumbre for considering an investigation into André Mendonça. The senator expressed disappointment with the Senate president's stance.

item.title: Convidado para desfile de 7 de Setembro, Moraes não deve ir a evento em Brasília ao lado de Lula
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes will not attend the September 7th parade in Brasília despite an invitation from President Lula's government, amid the crisis involving the Master case and STF investigations. The event will feature themes such as femicide prevention and vaccination with a sober tone, avoiding electoral propaganda. Lula seeks to distance himself from the Court crisis, demanding actions from the STF president and the Attorney General's Office.

item.title: Gabinete de Moraes é o gabinete da perseguição, diz Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accused Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes of leading a 'persecution cabinet,' citing alleged irregularities in a contract involving the minister's wife and denouncing political persecution against right-wing figures like Minister André Mendonça. Following a visit to imprisoned Filipe Martins, who is serving a sentence for an attempted coup, he intensified his criticism of the Supreme Court, alongside allies such as Sergio Moro and Filipe Barros.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que julgamento do 8 de Janeiro foi uma ‘farsa’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro visited jailed ex-advisor Filipe Martins and criticized the January 8 trials as a farce orchestrated by Alexandre de Moraes. Accompanied by Sergio Moro, he defended Martins as unjustly convicted over an alleged forged coup memo. The visit symbolizes alliance among Bolsonaro supporters contesting judicial persecution.

item.title: Flávio acusa Moraes de usar Inquérito das Fake News para atacar adversários
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accused Supreme Court minister Alexandre de Moraes of using the Fake News Inquiry to persecute political opponents during a prison visit to Filipe Martins in Ponta Grossa. He claimed Moraes had a predetermined target and criticized the request to investigate fellow minister André Mendonça, which was set aside by the STF presidency.

item.title: Janja afasta apoiadora de abraço em Lula durante passeata no CE e vira alvo de críticas nas redes
item.description: Brazil's first lady Janja Lula da Silva faced backlash on social media after pushing away a supporter who tried to hug President Lula during a campaign walk in Juazeiro do Norte, Ceará. The video of the incident went viral, sparking polarized reactions from supporters and critics across the political spectrum who either condemned or defended her actions. The episode reignites debate over Janja's role in Lula's re-election campaign and her public image.

item.title: Candidato a deputado pelo PL imita Enéas em propaganda; assista
item.description: Thiago Felipe Neves (PL-SP), 42, running for federal deputy, mimicked Enéas Carneiro's speaking style in his campaign ad, adapting the slogan to 'My name is Neves'. He presents himself as a defender of social causes and animal rights, aligning with PL figures like Flávio Bolsonaro and Jair Bolsonaro. The ad went viral on social media.

item.title: "Sergio Moro sabe que não fiz nada de errado", diz Flávio sobre rachadinhas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated during a visit in Ponta Grossa that Sergio Moro acknowledges his innocence in the 'rachadinhas' case, framing past disagreements as resolved and reinforcing PL's alliance with Moro in the Paraná gubernatorial race. He praised Moro as a prominent figure and strong candidate despite previous criticisms from the former judge.

item.title: Zanin pede responsabilização de envolvidos após Deltan publicar dados de sigilo bancário do ministro
item.description: STF minister Cristiano Zanin requested accountability after former prosecutor Deltan Dallagnol attached confidential documents to his Senate candidacy process. Dallagnol's defense claimed the documents, from the CNMP, were submitted to counter electoral challenges. The Paraná Electoral Court ordered the documents to be sealed.

item.title: Caiado promete indicar 4 mulheres para o STF se eleito
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) pledged to appoint four women to the Supreme Court if elected, during an interview with Veja magazine. He also proposed judicial reforms, including raising the minimum age for justices and suspending Minister Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro visita ex-assessor do pai preso no Paraná e chama Moraes de 'laranja podre' no STF
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro visited jailed former advisor Filipe Martins and criticized Supreme Court justice Alexandre de Moraes, calling him a 'bad orange' within the STF. The visit took place during the campaign, and the candidate also attacked the minister's decision to suspend the Dosage Law, which could have kept Martins under house arrest. Other PL candidates, such as Sergio Moro and Filipe Barros, were also present at the prison.

item.title: Flávio mira “endividados” em programa eleitoral
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro launched his electoral program focused on indebted voters, promising to reduce interest rates and taxes. He criticizes Lula's government and blames the PT for family debt, proposing tax cuts to lower prices and increase purchasing power.

item.title: No Paraná, Flávio diz estar ‘decepcionado’ com Alcolumbre e volta a cobrar afastamento de Moraes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticized Davi Alcolumbre for not advancing impeachment requests against Alexandre de Moraes and advocated for opening processes against STF ministers. During an event in Paraná, the presidential candidate also addressed the crisis involving André Mendonça and accusations of political persecution in the Supreme Court.

item.title: Comício de Lula em SP tem críticas à família Bolsonaro e a Tarcísio
item.description: Lula spoke in São José do Rio Preto criticizing the Bolsonaro family and Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, questioning voters' choice of a Rio candidate over a USP graduate. Haddad and Tebet also attacked Flávio Bolsonaro and Tarcísio with allegations of corruption and controversial behavior.

item.title: Alexandre de Moraes é ‘laranja podre’ dentro do Supremo Tribunal Federal, diz Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accused Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes of being a 'bad apple' within the STF and advocated for institutional protection, while visiting jailed Filipe Martins. He also hinted at potential attacks with the slogan 'Out Lula, Out Moraes' and criticized the Senate President's inaction on impeachment requests against Moraes.

item.title: Zanin pede que Deltan seja responsabilizado por expor seu sigilo fiscal
item.description: STF Minister Cristiano Zanin asked the Paraná Electoral Court to hold Deltan Dallagnol accountable for exposing his confidential tax data in his Senate candidacy filing. The court sealed the documents, gave Dallagnol 24 hours to respond, and referred the case to the Public Ministry. His defense argues the 2023 conviction did not impose ineligibility or an 8-year political rights suspension.

item.title: Augusto Cury não declarou três empresas nos EUA ao TSE; campanha diz que é erro e corrigirá dados
item.description: Presidential candidate Augusto Cury (Avante) failed to declare three US companies in his TSE asset declaration. His campaign acknowledged the error, called the stakes insignificant, and said it will correct the filing.

item.title: Investigações sobre conteúdo golpista no Telegram fracassam por falta de dados
item.description: Three investigations into antidemocratic Telegram content were archived at the STF after the platform lost user data due to Marco Civil retention limits. The PGR flagged methodological flaws — screenshots without proper preservation — and Justice Alexandre de Moraes endorsed the closure.

item.title: Nova pesquisa Datafolha testa disputa Lula x Flávio no maior colégio eleitoral do país
item.description: A new Datafolha poll set to be released on Friday, April 11, will test Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in first and second round scenarios in São Paulo, Brazil's largest electoral college. The survey will measure rejection rates, vote consolidation, and evaluation of Lula's government, while also investigating the impact of the STF crisis involving Alexandre de Moraes, André Mendonça, and messages from banker Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Lula afirma que homem que bate em mulher deve ser preso
item.description: Lula stated that men who beat women should be jailed and pledged a tough stance against femicide if reelected. The remark underscores his campaign focus on security and women's rights.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro visita ex-assessor Filipe Martins na cadeia
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro visited former advisor Filipe Martins in prison, where he is serving a sentence for attempted coup. The court-approved visit carries symbolic weight among Bolsonaro supporters amid Flávio's attacks on Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Mendonça agiu com o fígado contra Moraes e não há chance de acordo de cavalheiros, diz advogada
item.description: Justice André Mendonça publicly released PF documents involving Justice Alexandre de Moraes, escalating the crisis within the STF. Legal expert Gisele Cittadino stated there is no room for a 'gentlemen's agreement' and that STF President Edson Fachin must act to preserve the institutions.

item.title: Ao falar sobre educação, Lula diz que no Brasil falta oportunidade
item.description: Speaking at UFSCar, Lula emphasized the need for more opportunities in Brazil and highlighted Brazilian competence, criticizing Tarcisio de Freitas and reinforcing Fernando Haddad's campaign. He also praised the SUS, favorably comparing Brazil's public healthcare to the North American system.

item.title: Zanin pede responsabilização de Deltan por expor seu sigilo fiscal
item.description: STF Minister Cristiano Zanin requested the Paraná Electoral Court to criminally prosecute Deltan Dallagnol for disclosing his tax and banking secrecy in his candidacy filing. A Metropoles report revealed Deltan attached information from Zanin, relatives, and his former law firm to the process. Only after the news broke did a federal judge order judicial secrecy over the documents.

item.title: Lula ‘provoca’ Trump com Pix e evita crise do STF em ato de campanha no interior de SP
item.description: Lula used a campaign event in São José do Rio Preto to criticize Donald Trump and defend the Pix payment system, saying he will raise the issue at the UN. He avoided commenting on the Supreme Court crisis involving Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça, focusing instead on trade issues and supporting Fernando Haddad.

item.title: José Dirceu anuncia fim do tratamento contra linfoma e celebra remissão da doença
item.description: Former Minister José Dirceu (PT) announced he has achieved remission from lymphoma after completing chemotherapy treatment at the Syrian-Lebanese Hospital. Despite his health improvement, he was advised to avoid street events for one month, limiting his campaign activities. Dirceu, 80, is running for federal deputy and represents one of the PT's key bets for the Chamber in 2026.

item.title: Nova pesquisa Datafolha testa disputa Tarcísio x Haddad pelo governo de SP e corrida ao Senado
item.description: A new Datafolha poll scheduled to be released on Friday, the 11th, will show the race between Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad for the government of São Paulo, testing the two in the first round and in a direct runoff. The survey will also update the race for the two São Paulo seats in the Senate.

item.title: Zema vai surfar em crise no STF e reforça discurso de que fez alertas sobre ministros antes
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) seeks to raise his political profile by leveraging the ongoing STF crisis to criticize justices and reinforce his narrative of having warned about the court earlier. The strategy aims to attract voters discontented with the judiciary.

item.title: É “abominável” que paulistas prefiram Tarcísio a Haddad, diz Lula
item.description: Lula harshly criticized paulista voters' preference for Tarcísio over Haddad, calling it 'abominable'. At a rally in São José do Rio Preto, he urged PT supporters to vote Haddad in the first round and attacked Tarcísio with corruption allegations linked to Master Bank.

item.title: Lula foge de temas polêmicos em discurso de campanha no interior de SP
item.description: Lula avoided controversial topics in his campaign speech in São José do Rio Preto, focusing on pledges like the Cell Phone Program and social indicators. The Supreme Court crisis involving discussions between ministers and banker Daniel Vorcaro was sidestepped. The candidate solicited votes for Haddad, Marina Silva, and Simone Tebet, without addressing public debt, citizen debt burden, or retail industry struggles.

item.title: Lula critica discurso de candidatos sobre futuro do país: "Cinismo"
item.description: President Lula (PT), during a visit to São José do Rio Preto (SP), criticized candidates who speak about the country's future with 'cynicism' amid the election campaign. He contrasted opponents' rhetoric with the situation he claims to have inherited in 2023, mentioning dismantled areas such as education and culture, and defended public investments including the new UFSCar campus in the city, which could offer up to 2,800 spots.

item.title: Janja é alvo de críticas por afastar eleitora de Lula: “Hipocrisia”
item.description: First Lady Janja Lula da Silva faced backlash on social media for trying to pull away a voter who hugged President Lula during an event in Ceará. The woman wrapped her arms around the president's neck, and Janja intervened. netizens and political figures like Rebeca Ramagem criticized her actions as hypocritical.

item.title: A ofensiva de Lula pelo sul do país para emplacar aliados
item.description: Less than a month before the first round, Lula visits southern Brazil to strengthen allies such as Gleisi Hoffmann, Juliana Brizola, and Manuela d'Ávila, a region mostly aligned with Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Sátira ironiza relação de ministros do STF com Vorcaro
item.description: Cartoonist André Guedes released an animated satirical video mocking the STF crisis involving justices and Daniel Vorcaro, referencing leaked contracts and messages. The parody questions ties between judges and businessmen, offering veiled criticisms of alleged collusion.

item.title: Com chuva e presença de apoiadores, Flávio visita Filipe Martins em cadeia
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro visited jailed Filipe Martins in Ponta Grossa, accompanied by supporters and political allies, in an agenda labeled personal but with strong political cargo. The lawyer called the detention 'illegal' and vowed to prioritize defending 'political prisoners' if elected.

item.title: Lula diz que distribuiria cerveja em comício se não fosse proibido
item.description: President Lula joked about distributing beer at the rally but noted that electoral laws prohibit such gifts. First Lady Janja sprayed water on him to cool off. The event featured high temperatures and several political figures.

item.title: Com Vorcaro no foco, pior para Flávio; com Moraes, Lula que se cuide
item.description: The Daniel Vorcaro scandal affects Flávio Bolsonaro and Alexandre de Moraes, but may also harm Lula due to his closeness to Moraes. The Supreme Court crisis undermines institutional confidence and complicates the 2026 electoral scenario.

item.title: Moraes levanta bola para defesa de Lulinha tentar afastar Mendonça de investigação
item.description: Alexandre de Moraes released PF reports questioning the impartiality of Minister André Mendonça, who is under investigation for allegedly favoring ACM Neto and dismissing suspicions against Fábio Luís Lula da Silva. The strategy aims to try to remove Mendonça from the probe investigating alleged corruption and abuse of power.

item.title: Primeira pesquisa Datafolha sobre a disputa Lula x Flávio após crise no STF testa também Cury no 2º turno
item.description: The latest Datafolha poll, the first since the STF crisis, measures the race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro with less than a month to go before the election, including first and second round scenarios and testing Augusto Cury in the second round.

item.title: Caminho livre para vice de Flávio: STF deve arquivar acusação contra Alfredo Gaspar
item.description: The STF is expected to archive the rape accusation against Alfredo Gaspar, candidate for vice-president on Flávio Bolsonaro's ticket, after investigations found no sufficient evidence to open an inquiry. The suspicion emerged after Gaspar announced his candidacy, but he always denied the accusations and even reported an alleged fabrication of the accusation by Lindbergh Farias.

item.title: Fernando Haddad: Vamos pegar o Estado de SP sem caixa e com déficit orçamentário
item.description: Fernando Haddad stated that if elected governor of São Paulo, he will inherit the state with a budget deficit and only R$5 billion in cash, criticizing Tarcísio de Freitas's management in economic, educational, health, and security areas. He highlighted the recovery of public accounts during his tenure as mayor and used fiscal issues as his main attack against the current governor.

item.title: Lula critica Tarcísio em SP, e Haddad associa governador a 'máfia do Master'
item.description: Lula criticized Tarcísio during a campaign event in São Paulo, referring to him as 'a guy from Rio de Janeiro' and claiming he did not carry out infrastructure works in the state. Fernando Haddad linked the governor to the 'Master mafia'. The event took place within an electoral campaign context.

item.title: Ódio a Moraes empolga mais a direita do que amor a Flávio
item.description: The text emphasizes that the September 7th far-right protests will focus on criticizing Minister Alexandre de Moraes and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, but the alleged 'hatred for Moraes' drives greater mobilization. Funding from banker Daniel Vorcaro to both figures is framed as a central issue, however, the tone suggests the right-wing is more energized by opposition to Moraes than by defending Flávio.

item.title: Lula: não quero depender da China e dos EUA, queremos inteligência artificial em português
item.description: Lula states that Brazil should not rely on China or the US for AI development and advocates for technology produced in Portuguese.

item.title: O conselho sobre o Pix que Lula diz que dará a Trump na ONU
item.description: Lula framed the Pix as a sovereignty issue in his campaign, mocking Trump by suggesting he adopt the Brazilian payment system. The Pix is targeted by U.S. tariffs for threatening the credit card market. Lula also advocated for technological independence in AI, rejecting reliance on either the U.S. or China.
